name: Cubic Spline Transfer Function with Indexed Caching
aliases: TF Management with Cubic Splines and Indexed Array
definition: A class managing 1D transfer functions for volume rendering, mapping scalar density values (0-255) to RGBA colors. It maintains control points for color and alpha, interpolates them using cubic splines, and caches results in a 256-entry indexed array and a 1D texture.
summary: Cubic Spline Transfer Function with Indexed Caching maps scalar densities to RGBA colors using cubic splines and caches results in a 256-entry array for fast integer lookup, decoupling smooth interpolation from discrete rendering.
